name: Monica Raymund
bio: Monica Maria Raymund (born July 26, 1986) is an American actress, director and producer. She is known for her roles as Jackie Quiñones on the Starz crime drama Hightown, Gabriela Dawson on the NBC drama Chicago Fire, Dana Lodge on the CBS legal drama The Good Wife, and Maria 'Ria' Torres on the Fox crime drama Lie to Me. She graduated from Juilliard in New York City. The character of Antonio Dawson (Jon Seda) on Chicago PD is sibling to her character of Gabriela Dawson on Chicago Fire.
